mainEntity.name: What is the difference between interior painting and interior finishing services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior painting primarily involves applying paint to walls, ceilings, and trim to change or refresh their color and protect surfaces. Interior finishing, however, is a broader term that encompasses painting along with other decorative and protective treatments applied to interior surfaces, such as staining woodwork, applying specialized textures, or installing crown molding. For Frasheski Construction, our interior painting services often include the detailed preparation and application needed to achieve a high-quality finish, ensuring a complete transformation of your living space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior painting is paint application, while interior finishing includes painting plus other surface treatments like staining or texturing. Our services cover both for a complete look.
